Criterion: Verify that emergency exit signs are installed and that each seated passenger is able to recognize at least one emergency exit sign. Standard (Air Force): Emergency exit lighting signs are provided that are powered integrally and operate independently of the main lighting system so that the lighting will be available when aircraft power is not. Exit location indications are also apparent when not lighted under normal flight conditions. There are a sufficient number of signs and they are located so that all passengers can locate an emergency exit based upon the viewing of one of the signs during adverse conditions that may occur during a crash such as the presence of smoke and water. Method of Compliance (Air Force): Verification is by inspection of engineering drawings and emergency egress demonstrations. Test and analysis of lighting systems verify functionality for all approved operating configurations and conditions. 14 CFR 25.812 applies to aircraft requiring FAA certification. References: JSSG-2010-13: 3.13.5 14 CFR 25.812, 23.812, 25.811
